patterns.key_values: ~256pt source list; two zones (documents/pages + layer tree); flat inset rounded selection (indigo tint, indigo text) for docs; saturated indigo capsule for selected layer; magenta component glyphs; indented vertical guide lines; dimmed hidden rows

floating opaque-white capsule pills over canvas (NOT unified titlebar); <=4 function groups [insert / crop / arrange / component]; borderless monochrome symbols + one full-colour brand diamond; leading standalone circular tool button
layer tree as outline view: per-row monochrome glyph + label, magenta for components, trailing boolean/mask markers, disclosure via indentation

signature_moves: Floating capsule toolbar: grouped opaque-white pill-clusters float over the canvas (chunked <=4 by function) instead of a unified titlebar toolbar — Sketch's chrome fingerprint
Two-hue layer semantics: indigo = selection/accent, magenta = component/symbol identity — object-type coded pre-attentively, kept orthogonal to the selection accent
Single full-colour brand diamond among monochrome toolbar glyphs (Von Restorff) draws the eye to insert/add
defects: Selection-grammar inconsistency — one source list uses a native-correct flat inset lavender fill for the selected document but a saturated full-bleed indigo capsule (white text) for the selected layer; the saturated capsule violates native selection grammar
Sidebar-header amplification (mild de-emphasis inversion) — 'Documents'/'Pages' rendered bold primary-black rather than HIG secondary-colour semibold
Accent possibly brand-bound not system-bound (contested) — indigo #545CFD selection accent rather than system blue #0088FF; single surface cannot disambiguate app-hardcoded vs user Indigo accent

aesthetic.direction: neo-grotesque product (SF Pro on white/neutral surfaces, single indigo accent, floating capsule chrome) — the app UI; the marketing composite around it is a separate editorial-warm brand skin (serif display + pink-lavender gradient)

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the one full-colour brand diamond among monochrome toolbar glyphs is the memorable/primary action (insert)
Jakob's Law — source-list sidebar + real traffic lights + layer outline tree match trained native + design-tool expectations
Miller/Cowan chunking — toolbar chunked into <=4 function-grouped capsule clusters for scan-not-decide use
Similarity grouping (Gestalt) — magenta=components vs gray=shapes/groups codes object-type pre-attentively in the layer tree
Aesthetic-usability effect — coherent neutral chrome buys first-contact trust for a pro tool
notes: Only input is a MARKETING COVER COMPOSITE, not clean app shots. Left ~55% is brand backdrop (pink->lavender gradient, black high-contrast serif display headline, diamond logo) — editorial-warm brand skin, analysed separately and excluded from UI tokens. Right ~45% is the real app window but CROPPED (right edge + window bottom cut off; canvas only partially visible). Render ~1x logical (traffic-light dot ~14-15px) so px≈pt; all UI metrics estimated ranges. Only ONE surface, light mode; no settings/empty-state/dark/inspector-detail evidence. Era not confidently Liquid-Glass: floating pills read opaque-white custom, not clearly LG lensing — glass classification insufficient-evidence. Accent indigo #545CFD is contested (brand vs user-accent). Sketch is a canonical native design tool; strong candidate anchor for a canvas-creative-tool cluster once a 2nd/3rd member (Figma-native, Pixelmator Pro, Linearity Curve) is digested.
